title: [29.x ]Trial Balance (Excel) report shows incorrect figures and formatting differences compared to Trial Balance (Obsolete) report in Business Central v28.2
summary: Trial Balance Excel reports now correctly apply global dimension filters (Department) when generating data, fixing incorrect figures that were appearing when dimension filters were combined with date filters.
key_points: Dimension filters are now read from the GL Account record and passed to the query-based data collection
Global Dimension 1 and 2 filters are applied via SetFilter on the query columns for both ending-date and opening-balance passes
RequestFilterFields are now included in the Excel reports to match the obsolete Trial Balance report behavior
The fix covers standard, budget, and consolidated trial balance reports that use the shared query-based codeunit
